arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. Please treat the gassy smell as serious. If you can smell gas now or it comes back: leave the flat, leave doors open behind you, don't use light switches, flames or anything electrical, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours) from outside. If you are ever in immediate danger call 999. Please don't use the oven until it's been checked. We are arranging for an engineer to look at the oven and the smell as a priority, with the target of within 24 hours. We'll be in touch with the visit details. Thank you.
